title: Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty
summary: Wikidata item Q169401, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "arms control agreement between the United States and the Soviet Union". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 11 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1373291390, argues the treaty out of the Euromissile deployments and the Zero Option of 1981-1983, and forward to the American withdrawal of 2019 and the Russian one of 2025; this atlas holds none of them. It never says the treaty ended the Cold War or produced any event this corpus holds, and saying so here would be this run's claim and not the article's. Unlike the prohibition treaty of 2017, it names no instrument the atlas has a record of.
